chunks: And whatever is in it from Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī Al-Kūfī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn Al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Al-Ḥusayn Al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh Al-Barqī, from Sharīf ibn Sābiq Al-Tiflīsī, from Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī Al-Kūfī.

key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: A nisbah identifying Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh Al-Barqī within the chain.
key_terms.الْفَضْلِ بْنِ أَبِي قُرَّةَ السَّمَنْدِ: The narrator to whom this transmission chain leads.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical hadith term indicating narration through a chain.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ الْمُتَوَكِّل: A transmitter in the documented sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī Al-Kūfī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu Al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Al-Faḍl ibn Abī Qurrah Al-Samandī Al-Kūfī. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission in hadith literature, establishing how the material in the book reaches this narrator.
